analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($174.96) below SMA5 ($181.85), above SMA20 ($166.06)/SMA50 ($161.45), below SMA100 ($173.19), and below SMA200 ($193.61): diagnosing short-term bearish, mid-term mixed, long-term bearish.
· -2.51% vs SMA100, -9.63% vs SMA200: confirming mid-to-long-term bearish strength.
· 52-week position (13.6%): current price level is approximately 30% above the 52-week low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (61.1 → 53.3): staying in neutral range, cooling from overbought then holding neutral.
· MACD histogram trajectory (4.3125 → 1.3834): improvement slowing, bullish expansion signal weakening.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $166.06): consolidating around the middle band, band width at 39.51% indicating reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($163.13): confirmed support based on SMA50.
· Swing Resistance ($176.48): aligns with Pivot R1 level, potential for upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal with 5-day low ($172.03) > 20-day low ($145.14).
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.58x): contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): lack of directional conviction due to neutral RSI, slowing MACD improvement, and contracted volume. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach, requiring confirmation of breakout above swing support ($163.13) or resistance ($176.48).
